Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kr. Yadav Warsi,Prabhat Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
1.Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the record.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the role assigned to the applicant is similar to what has been assigned to the co-accused Ajai Prakash Upadhyaya alias Ajai Kumar who has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 30.9.2022 passed in Bail Application No.11446 of 2022.

sentences.text: It is submitted that the applicant is an employee of the company.
Several other co-accused persons have been granted bail.
The applicant has been falsely implicated.
The applicant has no previous criminal Gyan Chand Kaushal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

The applicant is in jail since 27.3.2022.
Learned counsel for the applicant claims parity with the bail order of the co-accused Ajai Prakash Upadhyaya alias Ajai Kumar.

entities.text: Ajai Prakash Upadhyaya alias Ajai Kumar
entities.label: OTHER_PERSON

sentences.text: It is further submitted that there is no possibility of the applicant of fleeing away after being released on bail or tampering with the witnesses.
In case the applicant is enlarged on bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail.
3.Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid facts as argued by the learned counsel for the applicant.

4.Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, including the fact that charge-sheet has been filed, the applicant has no criminal history, the co-accused have already been enlarged on bail,
arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, the applicant is in jail since 27.3.2022, and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am prima facie satisfied that it is a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail and accordingly, the bail application is allowed on the ground of parity.
5.Let the applicant Gyan Chand Kaushal, involved in Case Crime No.0567 of 2021 under sections 409, 420, 506 I.P.C., P.S. Gomti Nagar, district Lucknow be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
(iii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iv) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(v) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.
In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(vi) In case the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicant fails Gyan Chand Kaushal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
